name: Advanced Techniques in Modelling Complex Systems
description: The future availability of local information in real time will fundamentally change the process of individual decision-making in complex systems, which are composed of many interacting parts showing a collective emergent behaviour. The relatively new science of agent-based modelling and simulation seems to offer promising tools to support decision-making in these situations, as it explicitly models the heterogeneity of the objects, which can adapt and interact in time and space.
prerequisites: Awareness and basic understanding of complexity as one of the biggest challenges of the network society. Basics of modelling networks and agents. Proficiency in selecting and applying the appropriate methods and tools for the simulation.
